title: GenuineMC Resourcepack
description: A small, semi-official resourcepack for GenuineMC Semi-Vanilla
body:
The GenuineMC Resourcepack is a small resourcepack designed to be used on GenuineMC Semi-Vanilla. It adds music by [dJ Blackbourne](https://www.youtube.com/@djblackbourne), represented on the server by custom music discs available in survival and soundtracks for server minigames.

![In-game display showing six custom music disc items and a jukebox block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/831b3fa7e80851c96106d280cb6af0fbde823545.png)

Disclaimers:
- **This resourcepack does *not* replace any textures**. It merely adds music disc textures as custom model data attached to the vanilla music disc 11. 
- Additionally, the pack is currently abbreviated "GenPack" in-game. We plan to change this in the next pack update for consistency and to avoid confusion.
- Finally, **this resourcepack is not officially affliated with GenuineMC, LLC.**
